title: Place a NO button next to YES and keep evasive behavior with changing label

requirements.text: On the proposal screen, display a clearly labeled "NO" button positioned side-by-side with the "YES!" button (same row on desktop; may wrap/stack responsively on small screens) before any evasive movement occurs.

quotes: Add a NO button side to YES button

acceptanceCriteria: On initial render, the NO button is visible and placed next to the YES button (with responsive behavior for small screens).
The NO button is visually distinct but consistent with the existing romantic theme and button styling.
The YES button remains clickable and continues to trigger the acceptance flow unchanged.

requirements.text: When the user tries to interact with the NO button (click, hover, or keyboard focus), it must move to a new position within the visible viewport/container bounds and change its label text each time (use English phrases), ensuring it never renders off-screen or under fixed UI elements.

quotes: and if no button is clicked it changes its position and title aslo

acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to click, hover, or focus the NO button triggers a reposition to a new on-screen location within safe bounds.
Each interaction increments an attempt count and updates the button label to a different English message (with the initial label reading "NO").
The NO button never becomes partially/fully off-screen and remains reachable/visible after it moves.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Backend remains single-actor; no backend changes are required for this UI-only update.
nonGoals: Do not change the fireworks timing/transition behavior after clicking YES.
Do not add new authentication, persistence, or backend endpoints.
Do not add additional screens or flows beyond adjusting the existing proposal screen button layout/behavior.
